$comment: Documentation contract for benchmark/holdouts/temporal-holdout-v1.json. The validator (benchmark/scripts/validate-temporal-holdout.mjs) enforces this shape against local git objects; no JSON-Schema tooling is used.
definitionCommitPolicy: outcome-blind provenance-only selection; no reward/activation/model result was consulted

freeze.commit: <full 40-char lowercase hex git SHA of the skill-knowledge freeze>
freeze.skillTree: <git tree id of the frozen skill path>
freeze.skillEntryBlob: <git blob id of the frozen SKILL.md>

candidateInventoryCommit: <full 40-char SHA of the main commit whose task inventory was fully audited>

clean-holdout: task first introduced after the freeze commit
every core knowledge card first introduced after the freeze AND absent from the frozen skill tree
core graded migration knowledge absent from the frozen skill corpus
the task judge materially depends on that post-freeze knowledge
eligibilityPolicy.primary: primaryTasks contains exactly the candidates classified clean-holdout

candidates.firstTaskCommit: <40-char SHA of the commit that first introduced the task directory on main history>

cards.firstCommit: <40-char SHA where the card id string first appeared under skills/>
cards.role: core|supporting (only on pre-freeze supporting citations of clean candidates)

coreJudgeDependency.rationale: <why the judge depends on post-freeze knowledge, or why not>

candidates.exclusionReason: <required for mixed and ineligible; null for clean-holdout>

primaryTasks: <currentTaskId of every clean-holdout candidate, and only those>
